ops.title: Bound query-index refresh work after known task mutations
ops.description: Owner: /root/fresh_disk_gap_relief. Independent finding after the PR127 body-read fix, official v0.74.19 source7606924, was installed. PublishRefs updates Git refs without synchronously updating query metadata; a changed or racy generation makes the next indexed task query capture namespace tips and diff them to discover an already-known own mutation. In the actual fresh-CLI CI proof with32/10000 tasks and three consecutive unique creates without re-priming, read/open bounds passed while pread grew from46-47 to303-307. Bytes and exclusive source attribution remain unmeasured; do not call total IO constant. Evidence: ccn129-consecutive-a99efb2.log, ccn129-productionlike-f826888.log; internal/store/store.go PublishRefs, query_source.go currentGeneration/capture, query_delta.go diffQueryMetadata. Next: measure actual query-index bytes and visited-tip work in CI, then propose a bounded incremental known-tip update using existing utilities, preserving external-write/crash/race invalidation and the unavailable-index path. No new watcher, daemon or custom journal without a concrete reviewed design. This follow-up does not hold independent body/cache gates.

ops.text: CI measures bytes and actual query-index work for32/10000 tasks across consecutive fresh unique creates without index re-priming.
Normal warm own task mutations avoid all-namespace tip capture solely to identify the known mutation; external writes, crashes and races still invalidate safely.
Optional unavailable-index fallback, exact task-content comparison and CreatedAt/ID duplicate winner remain unchanged.
Reviewed fix passes full CI, normal merge/public release/root-serialized install and a measured natural affected operation; no local synthetic corpus benchmark.
